text: Energy Information Administration, Annual Energy Outlook 2023 (AEO2023) *Includes utility-scale and end-use photovoltaic generation and excludes off-grid photovoltaics. **Includes petroleum, conventional hydroelectric power, geothermal, wood and other biomass, pumped storage, non-biogenic municipal waste in the electric power sector, refinery gas, still gas, batteries, chemicals, hydrogen, pitch, purchased steam, sulfur, and miscellaneous technologies.
